annotations.title: Save the cover letter of a job application (Bewerbung) as a draft

description: Use this when the user has agreed with you on the cover letter (Anschreiben) of a job application (Bewerbung) by email from draft_job_application, for a job from get_job_matches or list_saved_jobs. Saves it as this job’s draft, sends nothing; a second call replaces it. Then show recipient (empfaenger), subject (betreff) and cover letter (anschreiben), each in its own code block for copying, and `link` after them: it opens the draft in the Jobroulette app or browser, where the user copies or sends it. Scope: bewerbung:senden.
name: save_application_draft
title: Save the cover letter of a job application (Bewerbung) as a draft
